businessLogic.cleanSource:
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TFPrensadoFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_PrensadoFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFBobinaHoraSalida_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_BobinaHoraSalidaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_BobinaNoSerie = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'bobinaview_Execute')
	
	&IsAuthorized_PrensadoFecha = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensadoview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Prensado Bobina'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoBobinaWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.PrensadoBobinaWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	PrensadoBobinaId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	PrensadoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	BobinaId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	BobinaNoSerie.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	BobinaEstado.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	BobinaNo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	BobinaOrigen.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	BobinaKg.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	BobinaHoraSalida.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	BobinaCarreras.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	BobinaMinutosEnReposo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	BobinaReposoEnHoras.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	PrensadoBobinaCantCarrera.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	PrensadoOperadorId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	PrensadoOperadorNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	PrensadoPrensaId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(16).IsVisible
	PrensadoPrensaNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(17).IsVisible
	PrensadoTurnoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(18).IsVisible
	PrensadoTurnoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(19).IsVisible
	PrensadoProductoId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(20).IsVisible
	PrensadoProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(21).IsVisible
	PrensadoProductoTipoMaterial.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(22).IsVisible
	PrensadoFecha.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(23).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoBobinaId'
					&TFPrensadoBobinaId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoBobinaId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoId'
					&TFPrensadoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaId'
					&TFBobinaId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaNoSerie'
					&TFBobinaNoSerie = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaEstado'
					&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFBobinaEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaNo'
					&TFBobinaNo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaNo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaOrigen'
					&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaKg'
					&TFBobinaKg.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaKg_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaHoraSalida'
					&TFBobinaHoraSalida.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Set(&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Year(), &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Month(), &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaCarreras'
					&TFBobinaCarreras.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaCarreras_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaMinutosEnReposo'
					&TFBobinaMinutosEnReposo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaMinutosEnReposo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BobinaReposoEnHoras'
					&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBobinaReposoEnHoras_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoBobinaCantCarrera'
					&TFPrensadoBobinaCantCarrera.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoBobinaCantCarrera_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoOperadorId'
					&TFPrensadoOperadorId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoOperadorId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoOperadorNombre'
					&TFPrensadoOperadorNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPrensadoOperadorNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoPrensaId'
					&TFPrensadoPrensaId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoPrensaId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoPrensaNombre'
					&TFPrensadoPrensaNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPrensadoPrensaNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoTurnoId'
					&TFPrensadoTurnoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoTurnoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoTurnoNombre'
					&TFPrensadoTurnoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPrensadoTurnoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoProductoId'
					&TFPrensadoProductoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoProductoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoProductoNombre'
					&TFPrensadoProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFPrensadoProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoProductoTipoMaterial'
					&TFPrensadoProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFPrensadoProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFPrensadoProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'PrensadoFecha'
					&TFPrensadoFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFPrensadoFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFPrensadoFecha_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFPrensadoFecha_To.Set(&TFPrensadoFecha_To.Year(), &TFPrensadoFecha_To.Month(), &TFPrensadoFecha_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.PrensadoBobina.Link(TrnMode.Update, PrensadoBobinaId) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = DB.PrensadoBobina.Link(TrnMode.Delete, PrensadoBobinaId) Endif If (&IsAuthorized_BobinaNoSerie) BobinaNoSerie.Link = DB.BobinaView.Link(BobinaId, '') Endif If (&IsAuthorized_PrensadoFecha) PrensadoFecha.Link = DB.PrensadoView.Link(PrensadoId, '') Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.PrensadoBobinaWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.PrensadoBobinaWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.PrensadoBobinaWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.PrensadoBobina.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(PrensadoBobinaId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
